EC1: Use of any investigational [OR] or non-registered drug [OR] or vaccine product within 30 days preceding the administration of the study vaccine [OR] or planned use within the first six weeks of the study period
EC2: Has received any licensed [OR] or other investigational influenza vaccine [OR] within 3 months prior to enrollment in this study or expected receipt of any influenza vaccination before the Day 21 blood collection
EC3: History of excessive alcohol use [OR], drug abuse [OR] or significant psychiatric illness
EC4: Tobacco use within 3 months of enrollment and throughout first 6 months of the study
EC5: Has a chronic illness (e.g., liver [OR] or kidney disease), receiving a concomitant therapy or have any other condition that could interfere with the subject's participation in the study or in the interpretation of the study results
EC6: Clinically significant abnormal liver function tests at screening
EC7: Positive serology for HBsAg [OR], HCV [OR] or HIV antibodies
EC9: Having cancer [OR] or have received treatment for cancer [AND] within three years (persons with a history of cancer [AND] who are disease-free [NOT] without treatment for three years or more are eligible), excluding minor skin cancers, which are allowed unless located at the vaccination site
EC10: Persons with impaired immune responsiveness (of any cause), including diabetes mellitus [OR] and autoimmune disorders
EC11: Persons presently receiving or having a recent history of receiving (within the past six months) any medication [OR] or therapeutic modality that affects the immune system such as allergy shots [OR], immune globulin [OR], interferon [OR], immunomodulators [OR], radiation therapy [OR], cytotoxic drugs [OR] or drugs known to be frequently associated with significant major organ toxicity [OR], or systemic corticosteroids (oral [OR] or injectable). Inhaled and topical corticosteroids are allowed.
EC12: Persons with a history of severe allergic reaction [OR] after previous vaccinations or hypersensitivity to any seasonal influenza vaccine component
EC13: Persons with a history of Guillain-Barré Syndrome
EC14: Receipt of blood [OR] or blood products 8 weeks prior to vaccination [OR] or planned administration during the three week study period following vaccination
EC15: Donation of [OR] blood or blood products within 8 weeks prior to vaccination [OR] or during the three week study period following
EC16: An oral temperature [OR] >100.4° or acute disease within 72 hours prior to vaccination, defined as the presence of a moderate [OR] or severe illness (as determined by the investigator through medical history and physical examination; for example, those requiring an absence from work) with or without fever.
EC19: A clinical diagnosis of influenza within the previous 12 months
EC20: Any other condition or circumstance which, in the opinion of the Principal Investigator, poses an unacceptable risk for participation in the study
